name: push
declaration: unsafe fn push < 'a > (& mut self , entry : & 'a mut UnsafeListEntry < T >) -> & 'a T
documentation:
Pushes an entry onto the back of the list.

 # Safety

 The entry must remain allocated until the entry is removed from the
 list AND the caller who popped is done using the entry. Special
 care must be taken in the caller of `push` to ensure unwinding does
 not destroy the stack frame containing the entry.
rules: The entry must remain allocated until it has been removed from the list and the caller who popped it is done using it.
The caller of push must ensure unwinding does not destroy the stack frame containing the entry.
